items.title: Document Parallel Dispatch operator contract and memory boundary
items.context: Update the Lattice Parallel Wave decision doc so dispatch/status/merge/report are explicit non-authoritative operator surfaces, and state that project dev-memory is the existing public experience library, not new gate evidence.
items.userSees: Docs explain how to use Parallel Dispatch without confusing it with agent auto-spawn or authority evidence.

happy.desc: Docs list parallel_dispatch, parallel_status, parallel_merge_queue, and parallel_report as read-only operator surfaces and state their user-facing purpose.

edge.desc: Docs explicitly say the project public experience library is the existing dev-memory project/global JSONL storage and no duplicate story/history memory store is introduced.

adversarial.desc: Docs explicitly say dispatch/status/merge/report and dev-memory refs cannot satisfy REVIEW, TEST, DONE, delivery, receipt, or production authority gates and do not auto-spawn agents.

items.title: Add core dispatch, status, merge queue, and report projections
items.context: Extend the existing Parallel Wave model with schemas for dispatch manifests, wave status aggregation, serial merge queue guidance, and evidence/report summaries while preserving productionDone=false and receiptRefs=[].
items.userSees: CLI JSON can tell an operator what can run, what is blocked, what should merge first, and what evidence exists.

items.title: Expose CLI commands and policy/fact registrations
items.context: Add read-only CLI surfaces for parallel_dispatch, parallel_status, parallel_merge_queue, and parallel_report; register command policy, runtime/process fact level, and default phase availability without adding lifecycle mutations.
items.userSees: koala help shows the new commands and they behave like safe read-only operator tools.

items.title: Integrate project public experience library as bounded context
items.context: Reuse existing dev-memory storage by letting dispatch/report include limited non-authoritative experience references when requested; never let those refs satisfy checklist, review, TEST, DONE, or receipt gates.
items.userSees: Parallel planning can surface relevant project lessons while still labeling them as non-authoritative context.

items.title: Verify with focused smoke, build, policy checks, and Koala validation
items.context: Add a smoke test that proves dispatch/status/merge/report JSON shape, no-overwrite behavior, authority boundary, dev-memory boundary, command registration, policy registration, and fact-level registration. Run build and Koala validation before DONE.
items.userSees: Validation transcript shows the new operator surfaces work end-to-end and cannot promote authority.
